description: Single-record CMS config for editorially curated trending search term suggestions. Singleton pattern — only ever one document. Managed by site admin via Wix content editor. Consumed by Search Results page chips and cfutons_mobile SearchScreen (dallas/cm-c00).

fields.name: terms
fields.description: Ordered list of trending search term strings, e.g. ['futon frames', 'murphy beds', 'mattresses', 'platform beds']

notes: Singleton: only one record should exist. getTrendingSearches() queries with limit(1) and returns first record's terms.
If collection is empty, getTrendingSearches() returns hardcoded DEFAULT_TERMS as fallback.
Field name 'terms' is the cross-rig contract with cfutons_mobile (dallas/cm-c00 useConfig hook).
Collection name 'TrendingSearches' is fixed — do not rename without coordinating with dallas.
